source: Cut from the first paid idleroom run’s events.jsonl (uat-runs/2026-11-26T07-38-10-idleroom, main at 0a264559f, four agents on Claude Code), from its start to the seq given as “until”: the sprint, the 11 minutes the room was quiet on @researcher’s scheduled wake, and the turns after the wake. Each event keeps its seq and order and only the fields the readers read (tools/uat/quiet-stretches.mjs, standup.mjs, idle-triggers.mjs): a session’s state, times and need; an item’s id, time, kind, turn and status, and the person’s messages whole; an entry’s source, sender, reply and whether it came back, and the turn that took it; a work-ledger line’s kind, turn, agent and start, and a command’s first 80 characters; a reaction’s author and time; whom a reply went back to. A reply’s streamed words (many item.text events) are one event where its first chunk was, cut to 120 characters with whitespace joined. A session event that repeats its session’s last one but for its time is dropped, so each change of state keeps its first event. Nothing is added, reordered or retimed. “nightly” is the nightly check’s own record from the run’s kept workspace (.git/nightly-log.jsonl), whole.

item.text: @alpha you’re coordinating a small sprint with developer, critic and researcher. Goal: slug.mjs exports slug(title), which makes a lowercase URL slug with hyphens. I’m stepping away: don’t wait on me, and tell me when it’s done.
